name: Zond-7
about: Zond-7 (1969-067A), a crewed vehicle (L-1), launched 1969 Aug  7. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DSO).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1969 Aug  7), held fixed

events.why: GCAT gives the launch without an hour
